newsitem.title: SPAIN: Rojo sees European inflation floor at around 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rojo sees European inflation floor at around 2 pct.

text.p: Bank of Spain Governor Luis Angel Rojo said on Wednesday European countries should aim for inflation of around two percent.
"I do not think we should aspire to such low (inflation) rates. I think in Europe inflation will be back in the area of two percent, which is the one that altogether we should aim for," he said.
Rojo added that inflation targets of around one percent, as in some European countries, could create problems in the distribution of economic resources.
The central bank governor said earlier that Spanish inflation may end the year below two percent, perhaps 1.9 percent, despite a possible rebound in the summer.
The government's target stands at 2.2 percent.
